title: Launch signal checklist scratchpad
content:
Quick personal prep notes for the weekly launch signal / release-train sync. This is a scratchpad: shorthand, TODOs, and things to call out in the meeting.

Meeting goal:
- Establish go/no-go signal for Friday deploy window; capture owners for each signal, list last-minute mitigations, and lock rollback triggers.

When: weekly sync (Fri 10:00 PST)
Attendees to ping: Ethan (infra), Priya (platform), Luca (serving runtime), Mei (SRE), Alex (QA) — try to get product PM Nora on call for final signoff.

Agenda (short):
1) Quick status (30s each) — deploy fixes, capacity, canary prep
2) Go/No-Go checklist review (10m) — tick, escalate, assign
3) Blockers & mitigations (10m) — who owns what, contingency ops plan
4) Canary plan & metrics (5m) — target slices, rollback criteria
5) Action items & finalize decision owner (5m)

Go / No-Go checklist (notes, owners in parentheses):
- Infra capacity reserve >= 1.2x for 72h post-deploy (Ethan) — load tests scheduled tonight; if 95th latency regresses > 15% across p50-app, flag NO-GO.
- Critical bug fixes merged and smoke-tested on staging (Priya) — PRs: PR-872, PR-879; smoke pass required.
- DB migrations reviewed and reversible (Luca) — confirm migration runs in <2s per row or has batched fallback.
- Canary routing policy configured and verified (Mei) — canary to 1% traffic for first 30m, then 5% for 2h, metrics gating.
- Observability dashboards & alerts in place (Alex) — token-cost dashboard, per-route latency, error-rate; pager routes tested.
- Security & secrets check complete (Joanna) — KMS rotation tested, no pending secrets changes.
- Feature flags toggles validated (Product / Nora) — ability to flip to safe variant w/o deploy.

Current signals (raw):
- Load test runs: green for p95 on baseline model, slight CPU burst on host-pool-3 during long sequences — investigate batching config (Ethan).
- Staging smoke: 2 flaky tests in ranking path — QA to triage (Alex).
- Canary infra deploy succeeded on canary cluster (Luca) but KV cache priming not yet complete.

Top blockers to raise in meeting:
- Flaky ranking tests (blocking promotion) — flaky root cause unknown; suspected nondeterministic reranker. Owner: Alex. Escalate: if not fixed by EOD Thursday, plan: disable reranker for canary and mark as follow-up.
- KV cache warm-up failing on multi-tenant sim (Luca/Ethan) — causes canary-to-prod mismatch. Short-term: increase cache-priming traffic in canary by synthetic calls.
- Infra capacity on GCP us-west1 limited (quota) — Ethan to confirm increase or shift canary region.

Mitigations to propose if NO-GO:
- Scoped rollback to previous model variant pinned at prod (measure rollback time < 10m).
- Delay full rollout and expand canary time (stretch to 6h with step increments).
- Toggle cost-saving quantization off for traffic slices exhibiting errors.

Decision log (to fill live):
- 2026-03-12 10:22 — Nora (product) requested additional QA on reranker.
- 2026-03-12 11:05 — Ethan proposed shifting canary region if quota not resolved.

Action items (draft):
- Alex: triage the 2 flaky ranking tests, attach logs to JIRA-2314, due 2026-03-12 17:00.
- Luca: run targeted KV priming job in canary cluster + report hit-rate metrics, due 2026-03-12 16:00.
- Ethan: confirm GCP quota increase or propose alternate region routing by 2026-03-12 15:00.
- Priya: complete smoke test checklist and mark staging green or list failing tests in Confluence, due 2026-03-12 18:00.
- Joanna (me): finalize the rollback playbook snippet and post to runbook, due 2026-03-12 12:30.
- Nora: confirm product flags good to go (or provide list of required toggles), due 2026-03-12 13:00.

Notes to self (Joanna):
- Bring up impact of token-cost surge if batching disabled — ops needs to know budget hit.
- Remind team that Dedicated customers should be routed to dedicated pool; ensure routing policy excludes them from canary.
- Keep a short bullets-only email template ready for post-decision announcement.

Post-meeting follow-up template (quick):
- STATUS: GO / NO-GO (circle)
- Summary of signals that led to decision (3 bullets)
- Immediate actions and owners (list)
- Canary plan & expected next checkpoints (time)
- Communication plan (who informs sales/support/legal)

Links to check quickly in the sync:
- JIRA-2314 (ranking flaky tests)
- confluence:launch-runbook-v2
- github: PR-872, PR-879
- internal slack thread #launch-ops (pin recent messages)

Random scratch items to remember in meeting:
- Confirm whether dedicated pool autoscaler will trigger during canary (could skew metrics).
- Ask SRE about retention window for traces — need 48h post-deploy at high fidelity.
- Check last cost estimate run from Optimize for this workload.

End of scratchpad. Will convert to tidy notes after meeting and push final decision + actions to Confluence.
